Technical Program Manager

Albedo

IT, Operations

Broomfield, CO, USA

USD 167,450-180,523 / year + Equity

Posted on Aug 15, 2026

Be one of the Bedo 100

Albedo is making Very Low Earth Orbit (VLEO) mainstream, building the infrastructure to usher every satellite mission set into this new orbital domain. We build buses, integrated satellites, and turnkey missions for customers to thrive in VLEO, between 250 km - 400 km, where proximity compounds performance and drag self-cleans debris.

As part of the first 100 employees at Albedo, you will have a big impact on Albedo’s trajectory to proliferating VLEO — whether you’re advancing hardware to increase satellite longevity, scaling production for large constellations, building next-gen flight and ground software to push performance, or enabling missions that matter for national security and our day-to-day life here on earth.

How We Operate:
Albedo takes a first-principles approach — in space and in business. We move with speed, take calculated risks, and learn quickly. We use AI regularly to create leverage in every discipline across the company. We work in-person at our Broomfield CO HQ to maximize team and company productivity. We work hard and with urgency to compound our first-mover advantage.

Who We're Looking For:
Builders who want to own outcomes, not tasks. Systems thinkers who balance precision with iteration while thinking about the big picture. Individuals who are energized by creating a category rather than competing in an existing one. You’ll join a team that has already proven what others said wasn’t feasible and is now scaling and upgrading our VLEO buses & payloads to serve mission sets across sensing, communications, and responsive operations.

If you can feel the excitement running through your veins, apply to be one of the Bedo 100.

What You'll Do

Own the execution of projects and programs across the company, measured against Albedo's company goals and committed delivery dates.
Build and maintain the integrated schedule spanning engineering, production, and software: GNC, FSW, GSW, Comms, Systems, Electronics, Optical, Mechanical, Thermal, and Production, with a real critical path and explicit margin.
Work at the build-schedule depth, not the milestone-roll-up depth: AI&T flow, production sequencing, resource loading, test-stand and fixture contention, and long-lead procurement. You will be in the details with the people doing the work.
Partner with team leads and systems engineering to translate technical plans into durations they will stand behind and hold the line when those durations are optimistic.
Find slips before they are announced. Run the replan, quantify the options, and present a decision to the team.
Own the execution cadence and keep Linear accurate as the system of record, with health, status, and dependencies that leadership can trust.
Build the program-management practice: cadence, reporting, escalation, and schedule standards that others can run as we add programs and headcount.
Represent programs to external customers and partners where applicable, while keeping internal delivery ownership as the primary focus.

Your Ideal Skills And Experience

BS in EE, CE, Aero, or ME, or demonstrated equivalent technical fluency.
8+ years in program or engineering management for hardware programs, with at least one where they owned the detailed build or AI&T schedule.
Demonstrated task-level schedule ownership: resource-loaded plans, negotiated durations, and the critical path you can still explain.
Multi-disciplinary integration experience: has run a schedule spanning mechanical, electrical, software, and test, not a single-function plan.
Hardware production or integration and test exposure: has been on the floor or adjacent to it while something was being built.
CAPM/PMP a plus.

Salary Range

$167,450-$180,523

Compensation And Benefits For Full-Time Roles

Employee friendly equity compensation
4% direct matching 401k
Health Insurance: 100% employee coverage & 75% dependent coverage
Parental leave and childcare coverage
Flexible vacation and sick time from day one
12 company holidays
$100 monthly wellness benefit
Relocation package if not based in Denver

The final compensation package is subject to change if the candidate's experience and company need drive a different job level than originally slated for the position.

Albedo does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to Albedo employees. Albedo is not responsible for any fees or overhead related to unsolicited resumes.

Additional Requirements:
In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. All persons hired will be required to be a U.S. citizen, a lawful permanent resident of the U.S., or protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled:
Albedo is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Relocation:
Relocation support for this position is available

Applicants must be a U.S. Person
as defined under 22 CFR 120.62

Research shows that while men apply to jobs where they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other underrepresented people tend to only apply when they meet 100% of the qualifications. At Albedo, we'd rather hear from you. We care more about how you think than which boxes you check. We value people who do the math, make their assumptions explicit, and ask the annoying questions: what breaks, what's the failure mode, what has to be true for this to work? If that sounds like you, apply, even if you don't meet every line.

jobs.description:

Information, Please See

For over 50 years, Legal Aid Chicago has provided free civil legal

assistance to people living in poverty in metropolitan Chicago. Each

year our attorneys, volunteers, and staff help resolve civil legal

problems, including domestic violence, consumer fraud, and unfair

evictions. Legal Aid Chicago was founded on the philosophy that all

individuals are entitled to quality civil legal representation,

regardless of their income. We work to ensure that poverty is not an

impediment to justice.

Legal Aid Chicago offers a hybrid work environment. Our office, located

in downtown Chicago at 200 N. LaSalle Street, is ADA accessible and has

convenient access to public transportation and local expressways. This

position requires residency in the Chicago metropolitan area of Illinois

or Northwest Indiana. This position may require travel to court or other

outreach events.

Position:**Legal Aid Chicago seeks a full-time**Social Worker**to be a

part of its Client Support Services department (CSS). CSS staff are part

of an interdisciplinary legal services model, working with attorneys and

paralegals to provide holistic services to Legal Aid Chicago clients to

increase their stability and improve and sustain their legal outcomes.

This position is expected to primarily focus on our work with housing

advocacy, eviction defense, and/or nursing home residents who are

seeking disability benefits as they seek to transition back into the

community. The role may also include supporting clients across a diverse

range of legal issues and community-based needs.

The Social Worker reports to the Director of Client Support Services.

Responsibilities Include, Without Limitation

Assess client needs and link them to appropriate services, such as

rental assistance, self-help services, community mental health

services, job and housing services

Advocate for and support clients interaction with service providers,

caseworkers, and others, including independent review of reports,

treatment plans, and other materials issued by social services

agencies

Consult with Legal Aid Chicago attorneys and staff on behalf of

clients, including analysis of social work and mental health issues

impacting clients, and identification of services to resolve issues

which arise during the legal representation

Conduct follow up with other agencies and service providers to

ensure compliance with agreed upon or court-ordered services and

treatment

Participate in case acceptance and case evaluation meetings with

legal staff

Assist other staff in making informed decisions about case

management issues, including assessing clients capacity to benefit

from proposed services

Conduct independent research on issues relating to clients needs and

other social service issues and social science research to assist

legal staff in understanding larger, systemic issues impacting our

client population

Conduct in-house training and education for staff on mental health,

social work and other issues

Participate in community legal education for client groups and

service providers

Supervise social work internship students
Maintain case files and accurate timekeeping in electronic case

management system

Assist with grant reporting, as applicable
Perform such other duties as are reasonably related to the duties of

the Social Worker as may be assigned from time to time by the

supervisor

Salary And Benefits

This position is part of the National Organization of Legal Services

Workers, UAW Local 2320. The Collective Bargaining Agreement sets

employment terms and compensation is determined by the CBA salary scale,

based on paid experience.

The udgeted salary range for this position is \$65,803-\$71,001, which

reflects 0-10 years of paid, credited experience.

Legal Aid Chicago Offers a Comprehensive Benefits Package, Including

Bilingual Social Workers are eligible for an additional stipend

employment

Time Off: 15 vacation days and 18 sick days accrued within the first

year of employment

19 paid holidays, including four (4) floating holidays
Twelve weeks of Paid Parental Leave at 100% of the salary after six

months of employment

403(b) retirement plan with an employer contribution after one year

of employment

\$50,000 Basic Life and Accidental Death & Dismemberment insurance,

at no cost

Access to Employee Assistance Program resources, at no cost
Monthly internet stipend

employer for the federal public service loan forgiveness program

jobs.title: Bilingual Care Coordinator, Regular Full-Time, Intake: Labelle, Cornwall, Pembroke
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced registered nurse, physiotherapist, occupational therapist, social worker, dietitian, or speech language pathologist seeking a rewarding careers that cares for others, in a professional practics that cares for you? You're in the right place.

As a Bilingual Care Coordinator
, you will assess and determine patient care needs and eligibility, provide access and referrals to community services, and engage with patients, caregivers and other health care practitioners.

Whether you work in our office, in the community, or a health care facility – you will play a lead role in providing connected, accessible, patient-centered care – and be supported by our collaborative team that includes over 8,000 regulated health care and other professionals.

As a valued team member, your mission will be to help our patients be healthier at home, while you benefit from our supports for professional growth, personal wellness and work-life balance.

What will you do?

Under the general direction of the Manager,Patient Services, the Care Coordinator is responsible for managing a caseload of diverse patients who are living and/or dealing with a variety of health concerns. The Care Coordinator, through phone conversations, assesses the patient’s care needs and develops, implements, and updates (as required) a care plan that is informed by the patient’s health and psychosocial needs; and, where possible, accommodates patient and caregiver wishes. He/she also determines eligibility for and arranges for Ontario Health atHome Champlain-approved health care services and refers patients and caregivers to other community resources and programs.

As a member of the Intake Care Team, the Care Coordinator will be responsible for assessing and developing individual patient care plans over the phone for service provision. Based on patient needs the Care Coordinator will utilize a multi-disciplinary team approach to achieve optimal health outcomes. This is an in office, non-visiting role where referrals are prioritized based on the complexity, urgency and needs of each patient while adhering to Ontario Health atHome Champlain guidelines for care and services.

Primary Responsibilities

Completes comprehensive patient assessments using a validated assessment tool, including patient’s clinical, physical and psychosocial needs, and caregiver needs
Assesses the patient’s and caregiver’s understanding of, and learning needs related to diagnosis, treatment, available resources, illness adjustment, and coping mechanisms
Assists patient and caregiver in setting appropriate goals (individual, joint, short or long term)
Collaborates with patient, caregiver and the care team to develop an individualized care and service plan reflective of the patient’s identified priorities and desired outcomes; identifies strategies and resources to be used in attaining clinical outcomes
Coordinates the delivery of Home and community care services to patients and their caregivers
Coordinates vendor and resource utilization involving medical equipment, supplies and services
Facilitates understanding and cooperation among members of the patient’s multidisciplinary healthcare team; communicates with members of the patient’s health care team to maximize patient outcomes
Initiates and authorizes the implementation of the care plan through contracted providers
Provides regular reports to Physicians, service providers, patients, caregivers and other authorized parties as required
Case documentation in accordance with Ontario Health atHome Champlain policies

Team/Department:
Intake

Hours of work:
A rotating shift schedule comprised of eight-hour shifts with various start times between the hours of 8am and 8pm, seven days/week for a total of 70-hours biweekly

FTE:
1.0

Starting Salary:
$44.480 to $47.517

Affiliation:
ONA

Reporting to:
Manager, Patient Services

Office Location:
Cornwall, Labelle, Pembroke

What must you have?

Registered Nurse (BScN or diploma) and registered with the College of Nurses of Ontario; or
Degree or diploma in Physiotherapy and registered with the College of Physiotherapy of Ontario; or
Degree or diploma in Occupational Therapy and registered with the College of Occupational Therapy of Ontario; or
Degree in Social Work and registered with the Ontario College of Social Workers and Social Service Workers; or
Degree in Speech Therapy and registered with the College of Audiologists and Speech-Language Pathologists of Ontario; or
Degree in Foods and Nutrition or equivalent and registered with College of Dietitians of Ontario.
Related professional experience (community based experience preferred) which is normally attained over a period of two years

What would give you the edge?

Works with diverse patient groups with varying levels of comprehension and language capability
Manages difficult conversations/situations such as advance care planning and goals of care in a healthy and effective manner
Works effectively in both a team environment and independently as required
Verbal and written communication skills to establish working relationships and maintain a wide range of partners (doctors, nurses, social workers, etc.) within the healthcare community
Listening and facilitation skills to work with patients and their caregivers
Diplomacy in dealing with sensitive and/or confidential issues
Relationship building skills to develop and maintain health and community stakeholder partnerships.
Working knowledge of computer software (email, internet) and Microsoft Office applications (Word, Outlook, etc.)
A valid driver’s license and access to a vehicle is required
Fluency in English and French is required.
Vulnerable Sector Check completed within the last six months

Hours of Work

A rotating shift schedule comprised of eight-hour shifts with various start times between the hours of 8am and 8pm, seven days/week for a total of 70-hours biweekly

What do we offer?

We Know Wellness Is Supported With Work-life Balance. In An Inclusive Culture Committed To Support Your Passion For Continuous Learning, Growth And Innovation, We Offer

Attractive comprehensive compensation packages and benefits
Valuable development opportunities
Membership in a world class defined benefit pension plan
Salary: $44.480 to $47.517

Who are we?

We are Ontario Health atHome, ready to serve every person in Ontario.
We partner with patients and caregivers, family physicians, hospitals, long-term care and retirement homes, service providers and Ontario Health Teams, to deliver responsive, accessible, integrated, patient-centered care.

Why join us?

If you’re interested
in driving excellence in care and service delivery
, and seeking an unparalleled opportunity to lead and learn, partner and connect, care and be cared for, this is your home.

Equity, Inclusion, Diversity and Anti-Racism Commitment

Ontario Health atHome is committed to a culture of equity, inclusion, diversity and anti-racism. We are committed to attracting, engaging and developing a workforce that reflects the diverse communities we serve. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified applicants. Accommodations for persons with disabilities required during the recruitment process are available upon request.

We thank all applicants for their interest; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

jobs.title: Privacy Operations Program Manager
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

The Privacy Operations team is a pivotal part of the global privacy program at Stripe. Our vision is operational excellence—a team that is proactive, streamlined, and deeply embedded in the way Stripe works. Privacy Operations is the authoritative operational hub for privacy processes, enabling high-quality privacy experiences for users and data subjects, and owning clear and auditable documentation for internal stakeholders and external regulators. We partner with Privacy Legal and Privacy Engineering to protect user data.

What you'll do

In this role, you'll own the programs central to how Stripe handles privacy at scale. You'll drive end-to-end management across data subject requests, privacy impact assessments, records of processing activities, transfer impact assessments, and cookie compliance, making day-to-day decisions that keep operations regulatory-ready and auditable. You'll also identify where processes can be tightened or automated, and build the documentation and tooling that make the team's work consistent and sustainable.

You'll work as a key connector between Privacy Legal, Privacy Engineering, and cross-functional partners across the company, translating global privacy requirements into practical operations. As a primary point of contact for incoming privacy requests, you'll handle triage and routing, and build the playbooks and response libraries that allow the team to deliver high-quality, consistent privacy experiences for Stripe users and for the regulators who depend on clear, auditable records.

Responsibilities

Own end-to-end program management across core privacy programs such as data subject requests (DSRs), PIAs and DPIAs, records of processing activities (ROPA), transfer impact assessments (TIAs), and cookie compliance, making day-to-day operational decisions, enforcing processes to ensure regulatory readiness, and measuring compliance at scale
Identify and implement process improvements, including leveraging AI tooling to automate routine tasks, developing structured workflows to sustain quality standards, and maintaining accurate, auditable program records including playbooks and process documentation
Create and maintain clear, auditable privacy documentation, including privacy assessments, program playbooks, and customer response libraries, to provide scalable, consistent privacy operational support
Work with Privacy Legal and Privacy Engineering to fulfill user requests, build and deepen expertise on global privacy and data-protection requirements, and escalate novel or complex requests with appropriate context and documentation
Rotate through the team's weekly runner model as the primary point of contact for incoming privacy requests, routing across intake channels and managing Jira run tickets

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements

5+ years of demonstrated privacy program management and a proven track record of operationalizing and scaling cross-functional organization-wide programs from the ground up
Excellent collaboration, communication, and relationship-building skills, and the ability to convey complex ideas succinctly to all audiences
Demonstrated experience with privacy legislation such as GDPR, CCPA, LGPD, and PIPEDA. Experience with US state legislation, HIPAA, and GLBA is a plus.
Hands-on experience with privacy impact assessments (PIAs and DPIAs), data subject request workflows, records of processing activities (ROPA), or other core privacy program operations
Ability to analyze complex problems to identify root causes and trends, and to document complex narratives in a simplified way that others can use
Curious and self-motivated with a strong affinity for vision setting, strategic problem solving, and driving outcomes
Experienced in juggling multiple projects in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, with tight timelines and shifting priorities
A team player, willing to pitch in where needed

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in fast-paced, high-growth environments. Previous tech industry experience is a plus.
Demonstrated experience using AI to accelerate day-to-day privacy operations work
Experience with third-party risk management, RFP and DDQ response processes, or cross-border transfer assessments
Privacy certification such as CIPP/E, CIPP/US, or CIPM is a plus

Working remotely at Stripe

A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $127,600 - $191,400. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

jobs.title: HealthLink 915 Team Leader
jobs.description:
Help Others, Make a Difference, Save a Life.

Do you want to make a difference in people's lives every day?

Or help people navigate the tough spots in their life?

And do it all while working where your hard work is appreciated?

You have a lot of choices in where you work…make the decision to work where you are valued!

Join the McNabb Center Team as the Healthlink Team Leader today!

The Healthlink Team Leader

Job Summary

Responsible for the direct supervision and oversight of a HealthLink Team to ensure that the team maintains compliance with all standards and meets or exceeds all internal/external expectations.
Oversight duties include ensuring that high quality clinical care is provided, monitoring program productivity, managing caseloads, managing HealthLink attestations/attributions/enrollments, monitoring clinical documentation, monitoring progress toward quality/efficiency metrics, conducting a variety of required reports, and directly managing front-line staff.
Provides coverage when needed to ensure all client needs and productivity targets are achieved.
This position requires utilizing a personal depend able vehicle to conduct Center business.
Maintaining a dependable vehicle and certified driver status is a condition of employment.

Job Duties/Responsibilities

This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive; and employee will also perform other reasonably related job responsibilities as assigned by immediate supervisor and other management as required. This organization reserves the right to revise or change job duties as the need arises. Moreover, management reserves the right to change job descriptions, job duties, or working schedules based on their duty to accommodate individuals with disabilities. This job description does not constitute a written or implied contract of employment.

Ensures that the Health Link program achieves its assigned productivity targets on a monthly basis.
Ensures that all clients assigned to the team receive a minimum of one face-to-face encounter per month.
Ensures that each Care Coordinator holds a caseload of a minimum of 85 clients, and contact each client on caseload at least 1x per month.
Maintains own case load of a minimum of 20 clients, and submits a total of 20 contacts per month.
Ensures that all clients assigned to the team have an up to date Care Plan/Crisis

Plan/DLA-20

Ensures each supervised Care Coordinator completes/submits all documentation within 2 days.
Reviews all documentation for accuracy and completeness- meets all funder and CARF guidelines.
Administrative/Reporting
Takes a lead role in hiring and retaining staff; maintains appropriate level of staffing.
Fills staff vacancies within 2 weeks of previous employee's termination.
Trains staff regarding program P&P and monthly productivity goals within one week of completing orientation.
Ensures each supervised Care Coordinator attends treatment team 3x a month and individual supervision weekly.
Ensures each supervised Care Coordinator completes required CARF modules

annually.

Maintain an up-to-date excel sheet to identify the currently enrolled clients in Health Link and the date of first contact each month
Review bimonthly and confirm each Health Link client's TennCare enrollment and potential renewal dates.
Submits team productivity report by the 5th of each month.
Prepares QA/QI and QRR reports for each program quarterly.
Meets Program Clinical Needs.
Works in a multi-disciplinary team to meet the needs of the SPMI population and

oversees clinical standards of the program.

Handles client inquiries and addresses issues as appropriate.
Responds to all flags, emails, and voicemail within 2 business days.
Completes all chart documentation within 2 business days.
Ensures that each Care Coordinator maintains a minimum caseload of 85 clients.
Ensures each care coordinator has adequate referrals, and referrals are assigned as needed and appropriate to the team.
Promotes and Maintains Positive Teamwork
Organizes and develops team cohesion during staff meetings.
Meets with staff on a consistent basis to address identified concerns.
Demonstrates consideration and concern for fellow workers and promotes harmonious relationships and attitudes.
Networking
Maintains positive relationships with internal departments to meet program needs and maximize growth.
Develops a positive and working relationship with outside agencies to meet program needs.
Gives and receives appropriate feedback.
Communicates directly with a problem-solving approach.

Compensation

Starting salary for this position is approximately $21.30 /hr based on relevant experience and education.

Experience

QUALIFICATIONS - Healthlink Team Leader

One-year experience in the social work field or a behavioral health setting required.
One-year experience in a supervisory capacity preferred.

Education / Knowledge

jobs.title: Technical Training Coordinator (Can Plant)
jobs.description:
Brief Description

POSITION SUMMARY:

Our Waco, TX facility manufactures aluminum beverage cans commonly used for soft drinks, beers, energy drinks, teas and non-carbonated beverages. Using state of the art can-making technology, this high speed environment provides rewarding manufacturing opportunities.

The Technical Training Coordinator works directly under the leadership of the Continuous Improvement (CI) Specialist to build, deliver, and sustain standardized technical training programs across our high-speed aluminum beverage can manufacturing facility.

This position serves as the primary operational partner to the CI Specialist, translating continuous improvement plans, standardized work instructions, and lean methodologies into effective, hands-on training for production line operators and plant personnel. The Technical Training Coordinator bridges the gap between process strategy and shop-floor execution to drive operational excellence, equipment efficiency, product quality, and workplace safety.

Essential Job Functions

STANDARDIZED WORK & PROGRAM EXECUTION (SUPPORTING CI STRATEGY)

Collaborate directly with the Continuous Improvement Specialist and process owners to create, update, and sustain position-specific training plans (new hire, annual, and refresher training) across all line operations.
Partner with the CI Specialist to update and document all Training guides: Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Work Instructions (WIs), One Point Lessons (OPLs), and assist with plant-wide management system standardization.
Help shape and execute new and existing training strategies designed by the CI Specialist and plant leadership.

HANDS-ON TECHNICAL TRAINING & DELIVERY

Provide technical, hands-on training to shop-floor teams regarding the operation, routine maintenance, and troubleshooting of aluminum can manufacturing machinery and systems.
Coach employees on equipment manufacturer instructions, safety procedures, and proper machine tooling and hand tool usage.
Coach Leadership Courses, (Beginner to Advanced) to foster diversity and inclusion, while inspiring teams through Cultural Leadership.
Educate teams on core Lean and Continuous Improvement methodologies (e.g., DMAIC, PDCA, 6S, root cause analysis, FMEA, and Kaizen) under the direction of the CI Specialist.
Required to present, educate, train and facilitate both virtual and in-person workshops at all levels and to external audiences.

Skills Gap Analysis & Post-audit Reviews

Assist the CI Specialist in conducting individual and team skills gap analyses to identify performance trends and training needs.
Seek and gather information from management, employees and other departments regarding the effectiveness of completed training courses and materials, constantly seeking to improve.
Participate in quarterly post-training and post-audit reviews led by the CI Specialist, updating training modules based on audit findings and process maturity assessments.

QUALITY, SAFETY & PROBLEM SOLVING

Support the resolution of quality deficiencies identified by the Quality and CI teams by delivering targeted retraining modules to line operators.
Participate in daily plant problem-solving activities and join cross-functional improvement project teams led by the CI Specialist.
Ensure all training activities rigorously enforce safe work practices, Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) compliance, and chemical/environmental safety standards.

ADMINISTRATIVE

Collect and log data regarding employee knowledge retention, workflow procedures, and concept application.
Manage logistics for training events, including scheduling and resource allocation.
Recommend training materials and methods, order in house training equipment and manage the budget set for training
Market company training opportunities to employees and provide information on benefits to encourage participation. (Internal and External)
Attend seminars/workshops to learn new training methods and techniques and use the knowledge to prepare and coordinate future training sessions. (Train the Trainer)
Assist CI Specialist in developing and delivering Training Key Performance Indicators (KPI’s) for the site.

Requirements

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

Required

High School Diploma or GED equivalent
Minimum of 3 years of experience in a high-volume manufacturing or heavy process environment
Strong mechanical aptitude with hands-on experience working with machines, power tools, hand tools, and general tooling
Practical understanding of lean manufacturing concepts, standardized work, and root cause problem-solving techniques
Excellent verbal and written communication skills; ability to effectively train, present to, and collaborate with team members from diverse backgrounds
Self-starter capable of working under minimal supervision, adapting to changing schedules, and taking ownership to resolve plant challenges
Ability to navigate computer-based systems, enter and track data (SAP experience is a plus), and utilize learning/document management software
Willingness and proven ability to be critically available (on-call/after-hours) to respond to urgent plant-level operational issues.

Preferred

Advanced degree or certifications (e.g., Lean Six Sigma Black Belt).
Experience specifically within the aluminum or steel packaging/can manufacturing industry.
Lean Six Sigma certification or formal training in process improvement methodologies.
Experience with managing technical training processes

General Skills/Experience

Aptitude in spatial reasoning, attention to detail, and skilled craftsmanship
Mechanical aptitude and experience (work with machines and general tooling)
Skilled in hand and power tool usage
Knowledge of SAP and inventory management a plus
Ability to operate heavy machinery
Ability to follow proper safety procedures
Proactive and takes ownership to resolve problems and issues
Ability to work with employees from many different cultures and backgrounds
Strong organizational and planning skills and housekeeping standards.
Ability to plan and execute major tasks.
Willing to participate in meetings and work with all teams.
Demonstrate and initiate safe work practices.
Self-starter, capable of self-supervision and willing to accept a variety of assignments.
Ability to identify and implement process improvements or efficiencies leading to cost reductions.
Strives to enhance the overall knowledge and performance level of self and others.
A demonstrated experience where quick-thinking and problem solving plays a critical role
Preference will be given to qualified local candidates

Software/Computer Skills & Experience

General knowledge of basic accessing information on the computer or entering data in a computer system

Disclaimer

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. Management maintains the right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.

Environmental & Physical Factors

The physical demands and work environment described below represent the activities and surroundings of the position(s). Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Works primarily in a warehouse/manufacturing facility. Daily contact with other departmental personnel. Occasionally works in all weather conditions, extreme temperatures, around chemicals and chemical fumes/emissions, dusty & clean environments. Frequently works with electrical and mechanical hazards. When working with surplus and scrap materials, will frequently be required to work outside and/or in an unaired conditioned warehouse. Continuous use of vision, hearing and speech. Frequent sitting, standing, walking and occasional bending. Will lift, carry, pull / push, and reach for supplies and on occasion lifting (up to 50 lbs.) while performing various aspects of the job. Will need to climb stairs, climb ladders, lift and move objects, requires manual dexterity and repetitive use of keyboard/computer devices/power tools/machining equipment; Wear safety equipment, such as earplugs, goggles, and steel-toed shoes.

Monday-Friday 8am-5pm; present to fulfill job duties & meet operational demands/support; schedule may vary depending on plant operational needs thus flexibility is required which could include long days, occasional evening & weekends; regular and predictable attendance is an essential function of this position; position may require travel to meetings, conferences, workshops or other facilities

jobs.description:
Organization- Miraval The Red Sea

Summary

Job Title: Guest Experience Planning Supervisor

Location:
Spa & Wellness, Miraval The Red Sea, Saudi Arabia

Department:
Spa & Wellness Operations

Reports To:
Experience Planning Manager

Position Summary

The Guest Experience Planning Supervisor supports the daily operation of the Experience Planning team and ensures guests receive seamless, personalized service from pre-arrival through departure.

Working closely with Reservations, Front Office, Concierge, Sales, Events Planning, and Spa & Wellness Operations
, the Supervisor ensures guest preferences, wellness intentions, special requests, and stay details are translated into accurate and well-balanced itineraries.

The role supervises daily planning activities, supports Experience Planners with complex guest requests, and ensures bookings and schedules are effectively managed through Book4Time
. The Supervisor also supports the coordination of retreats, groups, and special programs
and ensures clear communication between all operational teams.

Strong working knowledge of Opera and Book4Time
is required to maintain accurate guest information, optimize bookings, and support smooth daily operations.

Key Responsibilities

Guest Experience Planning

Supervise the daily activities of the Experience Planning team and ensure consistent service standards.
Support pre-arrival and in-house itinerary planning based on guest preferences, wellness goals, packages, and special requests.
Review guest itineraries to ensure they are personalized, balanced, accurate, and operationally achievable.
Assist Experience Planners with complex bookings, VIP guests, special occasions, and last-minute requests.
Proactively identify opportunities to enhance and personalize the guest journey.
Engage directly with guests when additional assistance or supervisory support is required.

Reservations, Front Office & Concierge Coordination

Work closely with Reservations and Front Office to review upcoming arrivals and ensure guest itineraries are planned in advance.
Ensure guest preferences, stay details, VIP information, package inclusions, and special requests are communicated and actioned.
Coordinate with Concierge to align resort activities and guest requests with spa and wellness itineraries.
Monitor changes to arrivals, departures, room reservations, or stay details that may impact scheduled experiences.
Ensure clear daily communication and handovers between Experience Planning and relevant operational departments.
Follow up on outstanding guest requests to ensure timely resolution.

Book4Time & Booking Management

Maintain strong operational knowledge of Book4Time and support the team with daily booking requirements.
Monitor bookings, availability, practitioner schedules, activity capacity, waitlists, cancellations, and guest requests.
Optimize bookings and available capacity to support smooth operations and guest satisfaction.
Identify booking gaps, scheduling conflicts, and capacity challenges and escalate or coordinate solutions with the Experience Planning Manager and Head of Scheduling.
Ensure bookings, changes, cancellations, preferences, and guest notes are accurately recorded in Book4Time.
Monitor high-demand experiences and support the team in identifying suitable alternatives for guests.

Opera & Guest Information

Maintain strong working knowledge of Opera PMS and use guest reservation information to support itinerary planning.
Review guest profiles, arrival and departure details, preferences, VIP status, and special requests.
Ensure relevant guest information is accurately reflected and aligned between Opera and Book4Time.
Coordinate with Reservations and Front Office regarding changes that may affect guest itineraries or experience bookings.

Retreats, Groups & Events

Work closely with Sales and Events Planning teams to support itinerary coordination for retreats, groups, and special programs.
Coordinate group activities, spa and wellness experiences, and special requests based on agreed group requirements.
Ensure group and retreat bookings are accurately entered and managed within Book4Time.
Monitor group schedules and capacity to ensure individual guest operations are balanced alongside group requirements.
Communicate changes and operational requirements to Experience Planning and relevant Spa & Wellness teams.

Daily Operations & Service Excellence

Review daily and upcoming schedules to ensure bookings are accurate, balanced, and aligned with operational capacity.
Conduct daily briefings and communicate VIP arrivals, groups, retreats, special requests, operational changes, and key priorities.
Monitor outstanding requests, waitlists, and follow-ups to ensure timely completion.
Support the Experience Planning Manager and Head of Scheduling in optimizing experience availability and utilization.
Assist with guest concerns and service recovery, ensuring issues are handled professionally and promptly.
Maintain accurate guest records and ensure confidentiality of guest information.
Support revenue opportunities through thoughtful recommendations and appropriate upselling of spa and wellness experiences.

Team Supervision & Development

Provide daily guidance, coaching, and operational support to Experience Planners.
Ensure team members follow established Experience Planning procedures and Miraval service standards.
Support training and development of new and existing Experience Planners.
Ensure the team maintains strong knowledge of Book4Time, Opera, Miraval experiences, treatments, programs, and resort offerings.
Monitor team performance and provide feedback to the Experience Planning Manager.
Promote teamwork, accountability, mindfulness, and effective cross-departmental communication.

Qualifications

Qualifications & Experience

Minimum 2–3 years of experience in luxury hospitality, spa & wellness, reservations, concierge, Front Office, or guest experience.
Previous supervisory or team-leader experience is preferred.
Strong working knowledge of Opera and Book4Time is required.
Strong understanding of reservations, guest journey planning, booking management, and luxury service standards.
Experience coordinating guest itineraries, bookings, capacity, and special requests.
Experience supporting groups, retreats, and events is preferred.
Familiarity with spa treatments, wellness programs, fitness, and experiential hospitality is an advantage.
Fluent in English; Arabic is an advantage.
Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality Management or a related field is preferred.

Skills & Abilities

Strong supervisory and team coordination skills.
Excellent organizational and planning abilities with high attention to detail.
Strong operational knowledge of Opera and Book4Time.
Ability to manage and optimize guest bookings, schedules, and capacity.
Excellent communication and cross-departmental coordination skills.
Warm, professional, and guest-focused service approach.
Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
Ability to remain calm and organized in a fast-paced luxury environment.
Commercial awareness and ability to identify appropriate upselling opportunities.
Naturally aligned with Miraval’s values of presence, compassion, mindfulness, and transformation.
Flexible schedule availability, including weekends and holidays.

JOB PURPOSE AND REPORTING STRUCTURE:
Under supervision of the CCS Program Manager, the Rehabilitation Specialist/Case Manager provides support and assists in developing functional living skills to consumers who are enrolled in the Comprehensive Community Service Program (CCS).

This includes, but is not limited to: housing, medication management, employment, money management and budgeting, education as well as social, spiritual and recreational services.

This position requires attention and responsiveness to a consumer’s changing needs, condition and goals for their participation in the CCS Program. The rehabilitation Specialist works in close collaboration with the consumer’s Care Coordinator, therapist(s) and other identified CCS service providers.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Work with CCS Care Coordinators and other team members to ensure clients receive appropriate and high quality care; including referrals for services, ongoing monitoring and service coordination.
Complete home visits and appropriate services as needed and in accordance with clients Recovery Plan of Care (RPOC).
Assist clients in the completion of daily living skills such as but not limited to; upkeep of their living environment, budgeting and overall money management, appointment scheduling and basic medication management.
Assist clients in finding housing, medical and mental health assistance, obtaining legal assistance and benefits, in finding employment, training and education, ADL assistance, development of social support systems, AODA services and support, etc.
Coordinate transportation for clients to and from appointments, to include medical and mental health, shopping, housing, etc.
Maintain records of client contacts and complete ongoing documentation in electronic record database.
May provide transportation to clients on occasion.
Attend and actively participate in departmental meetings and meetings with other service agencies.
Complete and maintain all required paperwork, records, documents, etc.
Other duties as assigned

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE:
High School Diploma (required) and a minimum of 30 hours training/experience in recovery treatment and/or Certified Nursing Assistant training. Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Human Services field (preferred).

jobs.description:
*Job Summary and Responsibilities*

As our *Peer Counselor Program Coordinator*, you will plan, coordinate, implement, and evaluate breastfeeding peer counselor programs for the Special Supplemental Nutrition Program for Women, Infants, and Children (WIC), designed to promote maternal and infant nutrition literacy, breastfeeding education and support, and individual and community wellness, working directly with pregnant and breastfeeding mothers in the WIC community.

Every day you will collaborate with community partners and external organizations to coordinate breastfeeding promotion events and programs, oversee the work of WIC Breastfeeding Peer Counselors, and serve as a liaison between WIC participants, healthcare providers, and other support agencies, developing strategies and resources in conjunction with community agencies, high schools, and groups in accordance with grant provisions.

To be successful in your role, you will need strong organizational, communication, and computer skills, including database management, along with independent and critical thinking, creativity, and discretion to navigate varied and evolving work situations.

Plans, coordinates, implements and evaluates the grant-funded breastfeeding peer counselor program in accordance with grant provisions and requirements.
Participates in identification of community health promotion needs and development/implementation of promotion activities related to WIC breastfeeding education and support.
Designs/develops health activities/tools for WIC communities/groups to effectively meet breastfeeding promotion needs.
Recruits community organizations for partnering on breastfeeding and maternal and infant nutrition education initiatives.
Collaborates on program marketing efforts including flier development, PowerPoint presentations, social marketing, etc.
Participates in development of grant applications and assists with data input, analysis and quarterly/annual reporting; attends training, meetings and other events hosted by granting agencies.
Job Requirements*Required
Bachelors Other in Health Education/Promotion or related field and two (2) years’ experience in community outreach, program planning and evaluation, upon hire and
one years’ experience providing breastfeeding support or
Five (5) years’ experience in health education and/or public health or community outreach, with experience in nutrition, physical activity, food justice, prevention programming, planning and evaluation or related experience and
one year experience in providing breastfeeding support and
International Board Certified Lactation Consultant, upon hire

Today, as Virginia Mason Franciscan Health, we remain deeply committed to healing the whole person – body, mind, and spirit – in the communities we serve. This commitment is strengthened by the diverse expertise and shared values brought together through our growth.

Our dedicated providers offer a full spectrum of health care services, from routine wellness to complex disease management, all grounded in rigorous research and education. Our comprehensive network of 10 hospitals and nearly 300 care sites strategically located across the greater Puget Sound region reflects our ongoing commitment to accessibility and comprehensive care.

We are proud of our pioneering medical advances and numerous awards and accreditations that reflect our dedication to excellence. When you join Virginia Mason Franciscan Health, you become part of a team that delivers top-quality, professional healthcare in modern, well-equipped facilities, and contributes to a legacy of service built on collaboration and shared purpose.

new_jobs.title: Rehabilitation Specialist/Case Manager
new_jobs.description:
JOB PURPOSE AND REPORTING STRUCTURE:
Under supervision of the CCS Program Manager, the Rehabilitation Specialist/Case Manager provides support and assists in developing functional living skills to consumers who are enrolled in the Comprehensive Community Service Program (CCS).

This includes, but is not limited to: housing, medication management, employment, money management and budgeting, education as well as social, spiritual and recreational services.

This position requires attention and responsiveness to a consumer’s changing needs, condition and goals for their participation in the CCS Program. The rehabilitation Specialist works in close collaboration with the consumer’s Care Coordinator, therapist(s) and other identified CCS service providers.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Work with CCS Care Coordinators and other team members to ensure clients receive appropriate and high quality care; including referrals for services, ongoing monitoring and service coordination.
Complete home visits and appropriate services as needed and in accordance with clients Recovery Plan of Care (RPOC).
Assist clients in the completion of daily living skills such as but not limited to; upkeep of their living environment, budgeting and overall money management, appointment scheduling and basic medication management.
Assist clients in finding housing, medical and mental health assistance, obtaining legal assistance and benefits, in finding employment, training and education, ADL assistance, development of social support systems, AODA services and support, etc.
Coordinate transportation for clients to and from appointments, to include medical and mental health, shopping, housing, etc.
Maintain records of client contacts and complete ongoing documentation in electronic record database.
May provide transportation to clients on occasion.
Attend and actively participate in departmental meetings and meetings with other service agencies.
Complete and maintain all required paperwork, records, documents, etc.
Other duties as assigned

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE:
High School Diploma (required) and a minimum of 30 hours training/experience in recovery treatment and/or Certified Nursing Assistant training. Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Human Services field (preferred).

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS:
Requires a valid WI driver’s license.
